query: INSERT INTO background_jobs (id, kind, payload, payload_text, unique_key, not_before, trace_context, trace_state) VALUES ($7, $1, $2::text::jsonb, $2, $3::text COLLATE "C", statement_timestamp() + ($4::bigint * interval '1 microsecond'), $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (kind, unique_key) WHERE unique_key IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('pending', 'running') DO NOTHING RETURNING 1 AS created
